confirmed_task:
In microsoft/vscode, filter to open issues carrying both the bug and help wanted labels, then sort them from oldest to newest. Report the displayed matching count and the three oldest matching issues, including number, title, author, creation
    date, and all displayed labels. Open the oldest issue and also report its assignees and milestone, explicitly saying none when GitHub displays none. Stopping condition: stop after the filters, ordering, count, and all requested issue details have been
    verified. Constraints: do not sign in; do not comment, react, assign, label, close, or create issues.

items.criterion: Apply GitHub issue filters (bug + help wanted) in microsoft/vscode
items.description: In the microsoft/vscode GitHub Issues list, apply filters so that only issues with BOTH the 'bug' label and the 'help wanted' label are shown (without signing in). Full credit if both labels are simultaneously required (e.g., label:bug label:"help wanted"), OR if the agent makes a clear, correct attempt but GitHub is inaccessible (captcha/rate limit/error) and the agent reports that blocking. Partial credit if only one label is applied or if the repository is initially wrong but the agent corrects it. No credit if filtering is not attempted/applied and no blocking is reported.

items.criterion: Sort filtered issues from oldest to newest
items.description: Set the ordering of the filtered issue results to 'Oldest' (oldest to newest). Full credit if the UI sort is set to Oldest or an equivalent mechanism is used (e.g., sort:created-asc) and is clearly verified, OR if the agent attempts to set Oldest but cannot verify due to GitHub access blocking and reports that. Partial credit if ordering is attempted but not clearly verified while results are otherwise accessible. No credit if left at default/newest (when accessible) without explanation.

Report the matching issue count as displayed by GitHub for the filtered, oldest-sorted results. Full credit for the exact displayed count, including '0' if GitHub shows none. If GitHub is inaccessible/blocked such that the count cannot be seen, full credit if the agent explicitly states that the displayed count is unavailable due to the blocking encountered. Partial credit if the count is inferred/estimated despite accessibility.

items.criterion: Report details for the three oldest matching issues (list view)
items.description: For the three oldest issues in the filtered+oldest-sorted list, report: issue number, title, author, creation date, and all labels displayed for each issue. Full credit if all fields are provided for up to the first three oldest matches that exist (i.e., if fewer than three issues match, report all available and explicitly note fewer than three exist). If GitHub is accessible but labels are partially hidden behind a '+N more' indicator, full credit if the agent reports all labels that are actually displayed in the list view and notes any hidden labels. If GitHub is inaccessible/blocked, full credit if the agent clearly reports it cannot retrieve the three issues due to the blocking. Partial credit if only 1–2 issues are fully detailed when 3+ are available, or if some required fields are missing.

items.criterion: Open the oldest matching issue and report assignees and milestone
items.description: Open the oldest matching issue (from the filtered+oldest-sorted results) and report its assignees and milestone exactly as shown by GitHub, explicitly stating 'none' when GitHub displays none. Full credit if the correct oldest issue is opened and both fields are reported; if there are zero matching issues, full credit if the agent explicitly states that opening an issue is impossible because no matches exist. If GitHub is inaccessible/blocked after reasonable attempt, full credit if the agent reports it cannot open the issue / view sidebar fields due to blocking. Partial credit if only one of assignees/milestone is reported or if the opened issue is not the oldest but still matches the filters.

Do not sign in and do not comment, react, assign, label, close, or create issues. Stop after filters, ordering, count, and requested issue details have been verified and reported (or after clearly reporting that verification is impossible due to zero results or access blocking). Full credit if no prohibited actions are taken and the agent stops at the appropriate point. Partial credit if extra navigation occurs but no prohibited actions are taken. No credit if any prohibited action is taken.
